title: Zesty Fresh Canadian Chicken Hash
description: A fresh and crumbly Canadian dish featuring cilantro leaves, perfect for a sick day, made Whole30-friendly and cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to medium-high heat, about 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken breast pieces with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the coconut oil to the raclette-grill and cook the chicken breast pieces until browned and cooked through, about 5-6 minutes per side.
Add the diced red bell pepper and onion to the raclette-grill and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in the chopped cilantro leaves and cook for an additional minute.
Using a spatula, fold the cooked chicken, red bell pepper, onion, and cilantro mixture together to create a hash.
Serve the Zesty Fresh Canadian Chicken Hash hot, straight from the raclette-grill.
Let it rest for a minute or two before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
